settings.content: Cloth is sold in half metres, but a Shopify cart line quantity is a whole number. One unit of stock is therefore half a metre, and a variant's price is the rate for that half metre. A cloth at 240/m is entered in Shopify as 120.

settings.label: Metres in one cut unit
settings.info: The metres one unit of stock represents. Must match the headless storefront's UNIT_METRES.

settings.label: Low stock below this many metres
Design collection handle prefix
settings.info: Collections whose handle starts with this are design book entries.

settings.label: Free delivery over (in your store currency, whole units)
settings.info: Prints the threshold on the cut list. Set the matching rate in Settings - Shipping; this does not price anything.

settings.content: This theme is the Liquid twin of the Nuxt storefront in the same repository. Both read the same products, the same design-* collections and the same custom.* metafields, so either one can be the front of the shop.

settings.label: Headless storefront URL
settings.info: When set, canonical tags point at this origin so the headless site owns the search result while Liquid keeps serving checkout.

settings.label: Point canonical tags at the headless storefront
Expose the ?view=json-feed data views
settings.info: Lets a headless front read the same fabric shape from this theme without a Storefront API token.

settings.label: WhatsApp Business number
settings.info: Digits only, with country code, e.g. 919820000000. Leave empty to hide the button.

settings.label: Prefilled WhatsApp message
settings.default: Hi, I'm enquiring about your fabrics on the website.

settings.label: Load Cormorant Garamond and Inter from Google Fonts
Serif stack
settings.default: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'EB Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

settings.content: Shopify stores an option value as a name ("Indigo"), never a colour. The swatches are coloured from this table, matched on the handle of the option value the admin typed. An unlisted shade still works - it shows a neutral swatch until it is listed.

settings.label: Extra shades
settings.info: One per line, as name:hex - e.g. Firozi:#3fa9a3. These are added to the built-in table and override it on a clash.
